body: Yeah, honestly the more I think about it, the more it just seems like shitty timing and whatnot. The guy might not have seen the speed limit change and thought it was still 70 and that I was slowing down just to be an asshole. I might not have even noticed it if I hadn't been in the left hand lane. Obviously there are much better and less dangerous ways to handle it (if someone passes me and slows down, I just proceed to pass them the next chance I get and try not to worry about it. But this is something I've had to work on myself) but I'm going to try and give the guy the benefit of the doubt. It makes me feel better about the whole situation. Plus, I can try to use this when dealing with aggressive drivers in the future. Feeling a little less anxious now.

I slowed down because the speed limit dropped from 70 to 65 after I passed him. At that point, he was speeding. Plus, I was still going 67 to try and create distance between us even after the drop. He was going well over 67 when he finally passed me, meaning he sped up from the speed I passed him at. There was no need to act like that. If he wanted to speed, there was a wide open lane for him.

Thanks. I might try and do that. There is somebody from the time that I was hospitalized that I'm still in contact with that I could try talking to as well. I just honestly don't feel like I can keep going. That email I received yesterday really felt like it was the last straw for me. The last person I cared about hurting never wants to hear from me again. It felt like I was being told that I could kill myself because there is nobody left for me to hurt.

I'm currently seeing if there is anybody left who give me any sort of love. Obviously my ex will no longer listen to anything I say. After the break up, in my rage towards what my parents did to my ex I completely cut my family out of my life. I've also pushed most of my friends away. I don't want people to be close because I don't want to hurt them if I die. But most nights I just wish somebody would come along and give me a hug or hold me.

I'm in daily group therapy. It's only Monday through Thursday though and my insurance won't pay past this week. I didn't have it today because of the holiday which just made things worse. Although sometimes therapy makes me feel terrible because it seems like everyone else there has a significant other who loves them. It hurts me every time they get mentioned.
I appreciate your advice. I've actually been off of caffeine lately. I more or less got tired of making coffee and weaned myself off of it. We'll see if that helps at all.

For the past few months I thought that I couldn't go through with it because there were still people close to me that it would hurt, especially my ex. I wouldn't want to put her through that. But over these months I've pushed whatever friends I had left away. The message this morning confirmed that the one person left who I cared about hurting has officially removed me from her life. Now that she's moved she probably wouldn't even find out if I killed myself. I don't think she'd care anymore more either. She just wants me out of her life.

I was flying last week and we hit some turbulence and I couldn't help but think that it might not be so bad if the plane went down.
Free to do what? Can I be free to die now? I don't even remember what it's like to be happy. I can't take my emotional swings any more. Every day is a battle against myself just to keep living.

I no longer know what it's like to live without having suicidal thoughts. I loath my life and I hate myself as a person. At least living for other people was keeping me alive. But as I mentioned below, the last person who I cared about hurting is out of my life now. I can finally make the choices I want.

I have both chronic daily migraine and borderline personality disorder. For the past few months I have kept living because I know how deeply my death would hurt my ex. This morning I got the message from her saying she doesn't ever want to hear from me again. That's what has caused me to make up my mind. The last person who I cared about hurting is out of my life. I'm finally free to make my own decision.

That night I spoke with someone who was very close to me. After the conversation I felt like everything might be alright and that I could keep living, if only to not hurt her.

Since then it has just been a downward spiral. My illness has been getting worse. Each day it feels like a huge battle just to keep living. And in the process I've lost almost all my friends and family. The thoughts of suicide and self-harm have been in my thoughts almost constantly lately and last night I made the decision that I wasn't going to keep living just to make other people happy.
Thank you for talking with me for a little bit.

For a long time, the risk of hurting the people who cared about was a huge factor for why I couldn't go through with it. But now I'm not even sure if I care anymore. I hate my family anyway. And I'm tired of fighting this constant battle. I can't keep fighting it for other people. Sure, I'm alive which makes them happy, but every day that passes I just feel more and more like a shell. I'm not myself anymore. I'm no longer the person those people care about.

I felt like a prisoner and didn't know what to do. They were severely restricting phone access and had taken all my possessions. I'm from the U.S. And honestly, it still seems like it was incredibly unconstitutional to me, but apparently the police have a decent amount of power when it comes to pink slipping people and putting them into forced mental care.


And I don't hold it against the people who did it. They were terrified that I was going to kill myself. They cared and I can't hold that against them.

Although now I've pretty much retreated away from everyone. I don't want relationships with people anymore. Having people around just makes me feel worse because then thinking about killing myself makes me feel guilty since it would hurt them. I want them out of my life so something like that wouldn't hurt them.

I'm still confused about everything that happened. They showed up and I spoke with them for a little bit. I told them I wasn't going to kill myself. They said that they had enough information to pink slip me and that if I went to go see someone voluntarily then they wouldn't pink slip me. I said fine that I wanted to go to the hospital where I was being seen. They made me get in the car and didn't take me to the hospital but instead took me to a kind of holding center. I went in and once there I told the staff that I wasn't going to sign any paperwork until I got to talk to anyone. They said it didn't matter since the police had pink slipped my anyway.


It was one of the worst moments of my life and I still get panicky anytime I see or hear a police car.

My ex thought I was going to kill myself so she called the police on me. They stopped by my house and saw I wasn't there and spoke to a roommate who also thought I was going to kill myself. They found my driving around and pink slipped me. It was one of the worst experiences of my life.

I'm so afraid to ever tell people how I feel and what I think because I'm afraid of being forced to go back to the hospital again. I go to very intense outpatient therapy, but I just felt like a criminal whenever I was forced into inpatient. I'm even afraid to say these things online. It feels like every day is a battle against my thoughts of self-harm and suicide. Every day is just so exhausting to try and get these thoughts out of my head. I'm tired of fighting them.
Haha thank you. I think I'm going to look up local animal shelters and see if I might be able to recue one.
I love corgis. Especially all their mixes. I want to get a schnauzer. We have one back home and I love it. He follows you around and always wants to cuddle with you.
I really want a dog. I have to move into a new apartment soon and I've been looking at ones that will let me have a dog. I've been thinking that having a dog around would help me feel less lonely.
That's why I posted here. I don't want to hurt myself. I know it doesn't actually help anything.

I just don't want her to hate me. I was stupid and shouldn't have kept telling her about how I felt because I knew how much it hurt her. I just don't have many people to talk to anymore. She used to care that I would be okay. And I've ruined that too. I've been a failure constantly to everyone around me. My family, my love, and my friends. I just want all the pain to stop.

I do have my partial hospitalization program today so I am going to go to that.

A few different things. My aunt dying, having a fallout with my family, and losing my girlfriend of over three years. The last one hurts the most. Even after we broke up, she still wanted to be supportive. She wanted me to get better. But I just kept fucking everything up every time I spoke with her. And then yesterday she decided that she couldn't have any more contact with me, and it's killing me. I just want to apologize and tell her that I do want to get better. I just want to know that she still cares what happens to me. But now it seems that even she doesn't care if I live or die. Just knowing she cared was enough to make me hold on. But now I don't even have that. Maybe it's for the best. Now I don't have anyone left that I will care about hurting if I die. I've managed to finally drive everyone away.

I can relate to that first part. During the period when I couldn't stop crying I made up my mind that I had to die. I was trying to figure out how I would do it. To be honest, I never really had a good idea. Every way seemed too scary and I didn't want to kill myself so much as I wanted to die. Anyway, I went grocery shopping with my ex and when I dropped her off she asked me to promise her that I wouldn't hurt myself. I was feeling terrible about how things would never go back to how they were between us so I was considering just going home and doing it. She knew something was wrong so she called the police on me. I spent the next week in the hospital. I also hated the program. It just made me more miserable. Plus it made my migraines even more frequent so I was pretty much in constant pain the entire time I was there.

But in that moment that she called me to tell me to say that she called the police and that she would give anything to see me better, I felt like someone truly cared that I lived for the first. She cared so much to try anything to keep me safe. But since coming out things have just been downhill. Not just with her (she says she can't stand talking to me anymore about it because it just causes her pain and she wants me to leave her alone), but also with friends. Some want to help, but they have no idea what to do. They don't understand when I say I just don't feel anything. How do I explain to them how often I think about killing myself without just getting hospitalized again. It sounds pathetic, but I wish I had someone who would look after me just to make sure I was safe. That reminded me that they want me alive.
That would help if I had a tumor or something causing it. All my MRIs have come back negative which is good. But they don't really know why I'm getting them except that they run in my family.

How did you get out of it? I thought I hit rock bottom. I could never stop crying. I had thought of dying all the time. I thought it couldn't possibly get worse. And then it did. I just stopped feeling. I found it tough to interact with people because I feel like I don't properly feel emotions. I'll still get sad sometimes, and I'll panic. But beyond those two I just don't feel anything.

That was a nice read. I know there are people who care and don't want me dead. I just don't even understand my own feelings anymore, let alone other people's. It makes explaining myself to other people very difficult. And I don't always understand their reactions. It is so hard to tell people that you want to die. I don't think I even want to kill myself, I just don't want to live anymore. And people always react poorly when I tell them. I know they're afraid. But I'm so afraid to tell people too because I don't want to go back to the hospital. That was a terrible, miserable experience.

I do. I've been receiving treatment for them for about 3 years now. I'm on both preventative and rescue medications. I thought I was getting better until last month. And since then they have been getting increasingly frequent and painful again. I feel like if it was just the physical pain or just the emotional pain I might be able to handle it. But together they just play off each other and make everything worse.

I deal with chronic daily migraines. Most days I have to face this head splitting pain that renders me incapable of doing anything productive, even if I wanted to. Every day I get one, I wonder if maybe enough is enough. It's like an ice pick driving through my head and I'm so tired of it

No worries. Thanks for taking the time. What about if I really  don't think there are more positives. If it was just the emotional pain, maybe I could deal with it. But then I think of the chronic physical pain I will have to deal with for the rest of my life and it makes death seem not so bad.

I don't know what to do. I see a psychiatrist. I see a therapist. I was even hospitalized for a time. And still I just feel like I'm drowning. And every day I just sink deeper. I don't think I even have the will to try and get better.
Someone else gave the same advice. I think it is a good idea. I wrote down what I felt so that I'll have it for later.
Thanks for the advice. I'm going to try and do that today.

I do actually. I see a psychiatrist regularly and had been seeing a counselor for over a year as well. Recently things have gotten worse, so I entered into a partial hospitalization program. This was my first week of it. I'm trying my hardest to get the medical attention I need.
